questions.text: Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with TurOSI and/or Cordina.

questions.section: Questions for buyers of wholesale processed chicken meat
questions.text: Identify the factors you consider when choosing a supplier of processed chicken meat. Include in your response whether procurement is conducted nationally, by state or by groups of site(s), and whether the location of your site(s) affects which suppliers are considered. Which suppliers do you normally approach or would be invited to quote for your requirements?

questions.section: Questions for buyers of wholesale processed chicken meat
questions.text: Identify any constraints that may limit your ability to switch to different producers of wholesale processed chicken meat. In your response include whether other suppliers of wholesale chicken meat can meet your volume requirements, or any other relevant requirements. Have you switched suppliers in the last three years? If so, between which suppliers and why?

questions.section: Questions for buyers of wholesale processed chicken meat
questions.text: Based on your experience, do TurOSI and Cordina compete for your business or the same customers? Please provide examples.

questions.section: Questions for buyers of wholesale processed chicken meat
questions.text: Have you ever considered TurOSI and Cordina as potential suppliers for the same processed chicken meat requirement? If so, please describe the locations, products and volumes involved in the process and any other suppliers that you considered.

questions.section: Questions for suppliers of wholesale processed chicken meat
questions.text: Identify any primary or secondary chicken meat processing facilities you operate. In your response, please include the location of your facilities and the geographic areas that you distribute to (for example nationally or within particular states or regions).

questions.section: Questions for suppliers of wholesale processed chicken meat
questions.text: Are there limits on the geographic areas that you can supply? If so, please include in your response what influences this, for example transport cost, perishability, customer preference.

questions.section: Questions for suppliers of wholesale processed chicken meat
questions.text: Have you competed, and would you expect to compete in future, with TurOSI and/or Cordina for the same customers? If so, please identify the relevant customer segments, products and geographic areas.

questions.section: Questions for suppliers of wholesale processed chicken meat
questions.text: Do you currently have available capacity to increase supply of processed chicken meat? If so, please estimate the nature and scale of that capacity, the timeframe within which it could be utilised, and whether it could be directed towards customers currently supplied by TurOSI and/or Cordina.
Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
